caption_draft:
Six places to practise SQL, from your first SELECT to real datasets.

SQLBolt — https://sqlbolt.com/ — Lessons and exercises in your browser
SQLZoo — https://sqlzoo.net/wiki/SQL_Tutorial — No login needed
HackerRank SQL — https://www.hackerrank.com/domains/sql — From Basic Select to Advanced Join
CodeChef SQL — https://www.codechef.com/practice/sql-case-studies-topic-wise — 80+ SQL exercises on case studies
LeetCode SQL 50 — https://leetcode.com/studyplan/top-sql-50/ — 50 SQL questions in one plan
BigQuery sandbox — https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/sandbox — No credit card needed

Save this and solve one SQL question tonight. Send it to a friend who wants to start with data.

#sql #dataanalytics #database #firstyear #coding #practice #btech #notyourcollege
